## `things-cli` v0.11.0 — smaller JSON for agents

JSON listings are now sized for agents, and there is a new `things doctor` for checking database access. Most of the rest is a refactor of the write and import code, with no change in behaviour, plus a set of fixes to how `--when` times are sent and checked.

### Behaviour changes

- **`-j` listings print a default set of fields.** `list` views, `search` and `projects` used to print every field of every row. They now print the fields an agent needs to pick an item and act on it: uuid, title, type, status, start, startBucket, dates, reminder, project, area and heading titles, tags, repeating and checklist progress. Notes, parent uuids, sort indexes and the creation date are left out. On a 94-task list the output drops from 90 KB to 29 KB. `--fields all` prints the full record exactly as before, and `things show <uuid> -j` is unchanged. (#454)
- **`--fields` (`-f`) picks the keys yourself.** `things anytime -j --fields uuid,title,deadline` prints only those keys, in that order. Unknown names are refused with the `unknown field` token and the list of valid names. (#451, #459)
- **Weekdays and evening times are sent and checked.** `friday` and `friday@9pm` are sent as the date Things gives them (the next such day after today, so `saturday@9pm` on a Saturday is next week) and read back. `evening@6pm` is sent as `evening@18:00` and checked to be in This Evening today. `import` accepts and resolves them too. (#458)
- **A `--when` the CLI cannot check is reported as not confirmed.** An abbreviation such as `fri` or a phrase such as `next friday` that Things understood used to print the item as if confirmed. `add`, `project add`, `edit` and `import` now report it as `not confirmed (when not checked)` (JSON `confirmed: false, reason: when`), exit 0. (#453, #458)
- **Dated `--when` times are sent as a date.** `today@6pm`, `tomorrow@9am` and `<date>@<time>` are sent to Things as `YYYY-MM-DD@HH:MM` and read back, in `add`, `edit` and now `import`, so a time Things misfiles is caught. A bare 12-hour time such as `9:30pm` is sent as `21:30`. (#443, #446, #449)
- **Project refs say "project not found".** `open --project` and `project edit` refuse a ref that names a to-do, and every kind of miss (title, row number, uuid) now reports the project kind. (#448, #444, #445)

### New

- **`things doctor`** checks that the Things database can be found and opened, and reports a permission denial (Full Disk Access) as such. (#447)

### Also

- A padded `--list`, `--area` or `--heading` name is sent trimmed when only the trimmed name matches. A title that really has the spaces still matches as typed. `import` sends names as given. (#456)
- The missing-area and "--heading needs a list" warnings use one wording across `add`, `edit` and `import`, and a list given by uuid is named by its title. (#450)
- Large refactors of the import, edit and database code, each checked against the previous binary with a comparison runner now in `tools/compare/`. (#431–#455)
- The README puts Install first. (#457)
- The bundled skill and the docs at things.rlew.io are updated. Run `things skill install` after upgrading.

### Requirements

macOS with Things3 installed. Binaries for Apple Silicon (`darwin_arm64`) and Intel (`darwin_amd64`).
